name: Offline Banner
description: A dismissible banner that appears at the top of the page when the browser loses connectivity.
usage:
<OfflineBanner
  message="You are offline. Changes may not be saved."
  onDismiss={() => logDismiss()}
/>

anatomy.description: Top-of-page role="status" banner with aria-live="polite" that appears on the offline event and clears when the connection returns.
Caller-supplied warning text; wraps at narrow widths.
Labeled close button; the banner stays dismissed until the next offline transition.

dos: Say what offline means for the user's work, such as "Changes may not be saved".
Let the banner reappear on the next drop even if it was dismissed.
donts: Don't show it when the app is fully local and connectivity is irrelevant.
Don't auto-hide it on a timer; it clears itself when the connection returns.

examples.title: Default banner
examples.description: Appears automatically on the offline event and disappears when the connection returns.

examples.title: Custom message
examples.description: Tailored copy and dismiss label for product-specific offline behavior.

guidance.useWhen: Losing connectivity has real consequences — unsaved edits, stalled sync — and the user must be told immediately.
guidance.avoidWhen: A subtle always-on indicator is enough; use NetworkStatus instead.
guidance.behavior: Shows on the offline event, hides on the online event, stays hidden once dismissed until the next offline transition.
guidance.responsive: Spans the full viewport width and wraps its message at narrow widths.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the dismiss button.
Dismisses the banner when the dismiss button is focused.

notes: Rendered as role="status" with aria-live="polite" so the appearance is announced without stealing focus.
The dismiss button has an explicit accessible label.

props.defaultValue: You are offline. Changes may not be saved until the connection returns.

props.description: Accessible label for the dismiss button.

props.description: Called when the banner is dismissed.
